audit_scope: Tool trajectory and pinned hook only. No answer grading, prior answers/reviews, or hidden thinking analysis. Four planned trials retained.

definitions.tool_round: Unique assistant message.id containing at least one tool_use, not SDK turns.
definitions.evidence_arrival: Exact complete source lines actually returned; a location or advertised range is insufficient. Absence of a full span does not prove answer error, because alternative evidence may suffice.
definitions.volume: Unicode code points in tool_result text; excludes JSON metadata, assistant text and hidden thinking. Not tokens or verified billable dollars.

tool_return_volume.definition: Sum Unicode code points / UTF-8 bytes of user message tool_result content text only; excludes duplicate root tool_use_result payload, JSON framing, assistant text, hidden thinking and usage tokens.

read_overlap.definition: Exact frozen-source (path,line) pairs in Read results; repeat means same source line returned by a subsequent Read, not repeated reasoning or intention.

all_tools_source_overlap.note: Includes Grep-to-Read and search-preview-to-Read overlap, often useful navigation or contextual follow-up; not automatically waste.
